Actor Mushtaq Khan, known for 'Welcome', dies at 56

Actor Mushtaq Khan, who gained fame for his role in the film 'Welcome', has passed away at the age of 56. He was reportedly battling cancer and had been hospitalized for approximately 15 days. Khan was also known for his roles in 'Hera Pheri' and 'Mujhse Shaadi Karogi'. He had a career spanning over three decades in Hindi cinema. One report mentioned he died at Nanavati Hospital.
